posts.text:
TikTok has incredible moderation team.

Our InfoWars video about Multiple Horse Theory — the idea that there are many horses in the world and not just one — has been fully deemed misinformation and lost the formal appeals process.

Confirmed by Larry Ellison: There is only one horse on Earth.
